topic: Data mapping and model processing update
summary_markdown:
The session covered updates regarding data mapping processes. Several changes were implemented, including the creation of sessions from `facility_num_real` to `facility_name_virt` starting on 2022-09-15.

Key technical updates include:
*   A new mapping scheme was successfully integrated into an existing one (via `_v_facility_asset`), avoiding necessary changes in the Python code base.
*   The traffic factor has been added to this new mapping schema.
*   [me] will handle the re-aggregation process because the current aggregation script is highly dynamic and subject to change. [p2] acknowledged a previous link error.
decisions: A new data mapping scheme was implemented for facility name/number tracking.
